p: It is brought in the holy Zohar
"Your forefathers dwelt of old beyond the River":
for from a distant place He drew them near to Him."
That is, the bond of Yisrael with Hashem Yisbarach
comes from a very high and exalted place,
And this is what is hinted at in "beyond the River,"
כִּי נָהָר הוּא הַיּוֹצֵא מֵעֵדֶן (בְּרֵאשִׁית ב, י),
for the river is the one that "goes out of Eden" (Bereishis 2:10),
and it is the aspect of Binah, as is known;
and "beyond the River" is the aspect of Eden,
that which is above human grasp.
And the bond of Yisrael reaches up to there,
through what the holy Avos rooted in us.
And by means of this power
יוּכַל כָּל נֶפֶשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהִתְקָרֵב לְהַקְּדוּשָּׁה,
every Jewish soul is able to draw near to holiness,
even if it has become distant, chas v'shalom,
through the deeds that have passed over it,
And this is as we say:
"Remember the covenant of Avraham and the binding of Yitzchak,
and bring back the captivity of the tents of Yaakov."
בְּרִית אַבְרָהָם הוּא קְדוּשַּׁת אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
"The covenant of Avraham" is the holiness of Avraham Avinu, alav hashalom,
שֶׁהִשְׁרִישׁ בָּנוּ שֶׁנִּהְיֶה נִקְרָאִים בְּנֵי בְרִית,
which he rooted in us, so that we are called "children of the covenant,"
and "from the womb they are circumcised for Your Name."
Only Yisrael are called "children of the covenant,"
which is not so of the nations.
And through the holiness of the covenant
that Avraham Avinu, alav hashalom, received,
he came to the level of emunah,
"And You found his heart faithful before You."
And this power is rooted in the seed of Yisrael,
so that they are believers, the children of believers;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (מַכּוֹת כד, א):
"Chavakuk came and based them on one,
'And the righteous one shall live by his faith.'"
that is rooted in the souls of Yisrael,
one is able to revive his soul from the pit,
even if he has become distant from holiness.
וַעֲקֵידַת יִצְחָק הוּא בְּחִינַת מְסִירַת הַנֶּפֶשׁ שֶׁלּוֹ;
"The binding of Yitzchak" is the aspect of his self-sacrifice;
עַל יְדֵי הָעֲקֵידָה הִשְׁרִישׁ בָּנוּ גַּם כֵּן
through the Akeidah he also rooted in us
מוּכָן לִמְסוֹר נַפְשׁוֹ עַל קְדוּשַּׁת הַשֵּׁם,
ready to give up his life for the sanctification of Hashem's Name,
even the lightest and lowliest among Yisrael.
אִם יָכוֹפוּ אוֹתוֹ לְהָמִיר דָּתוֹ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם,
If they force him to abandon his faith, chas v'shalom,
אָז נִתְעוֹרֵר בּוֹ שׁוֹרֶשׁ פְּנִימִיּוּת הַקְּדוּשָּׁה
then the root of inner holiness awakens in him
as is brought in the holy sefarim.
"And bring back the captivity of the tents of Yaakov"
is the aspect of the power of Torah
שֶׁהִשְׁרִישׁ בָּנוּ יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם,
that Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom, rooted in us,
he who is called "a dweller of tents" (Bereishis 25:27).
וְהָעִיקָּר הוּא כֹּחַ שֶׁל תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה,
And the main thing is the power of Torah she'b'al peh,
"And the fourth river is the Pras,"
"It is the Pras of the beginning,"
הַיְינוּ שֶׁהוּא עִיקַּר הַנָּהָר הַיּוֹצֵא מֵעֵדֶן,
meaning that it is the essence of the river that goes out of Eden,
whose root is from the Source, as mentioned above.
of the power of Torah she'b'al peh
we become attached to the Source.
כִּי נְהַר פְּרָת הוּא הַגְּבוּל הַמַּפְסִיק
For the river Pras is the border that divides
וְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא בְּחִינַת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב,
and Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of the Written Torah,
כְּנֶגֶד בָּבֶל שֶׁהוּא כֹּחַ תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה,
as opposed to Bavel, which is the power of Torah she'b'al peh,
"Ezra came up from Bavel and established it, etc.,
and Rabbi Chiya and his sons established it";
"What I call yours is really theirs."
And the aspect of our bond with the Source,
which was rooted in us by the holy Avos,
נִתְעוֹרֵר בְּכָל נֶפֶשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה
is awakened in every Jewish soul on Rosh Hashanah
כִּדְאִיתָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג צט, ב):
as is brought in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 99b):
"And when this shofar is aroused, etc.,
then the upper shofar is aroused";
that is, the root of our bond,
at the level of "beyond the River."
And as is brought in the Rambam, z"l
the hint of the blowing of the shofar is:
For in truth all the souls of Yisrael
are bound inwardly at the root
רַק עַל יְדֵי הַמַּעֲשִׂים הַלֹּא טוֹבִים
only, through deeds that are not good,
the point in the heart has fallen asleep.
And when the awakening of the shofar comes,
then they wake from the sleep of folly,
and there is awakened in every Jewish soul
the bond of the point of the heart,
which is the aspect of the upper shofar,
and as a matter of course "all the workers of iniquity will be scattered."
And the essence of this power
stems from the aspect of the ram of Yitzchak,
as is brought in the holy Zohar (ibid. 99a–b):
"And this shofar is the ram of Yitzchak,
that is, the aspect of the gevuros of holiness.
And it is the shofar of the time to come,
וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִתָּקַע בְּשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל.
"And it shall be on that day that a great shofar will be blown."
And as is known from the statement of Chazal (Shabbos 89b)
that they will say to Yitzchak, "For You are our father,
for Avraham did not know us,
וְיִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יַכִּירָנוּ וְגוֹ׳ (יְשַׁעְיָה סג, טז).
and Yisrael does not recognize us, etc." (Yeshayahu 63:16).
For by the power of chesed and rachamim,
the aspect of Avraham and Yitzchak,
רַק דַּיְיקָא עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת גְּבוּרָה שֶׁבִּקְדוּשָּׁה.
but specifically through the aspect of gevurah of holiness.
And something of the great shofar of the time to come
יֵשׁ גַּם כֵּן הִתְעוֹרְרוּת עַתָּה בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה,
is also awakened now on Rosh Hashanah,
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה וּבָאוּ הָאוֹבְדִים בְּאֶרֶץ אַשּׁוּר,
and through this "those lost in the land of Ashur will come" —
that is, the souls that were assimilated among the kelipos
of heresy and denial, Rachmana litzlan;
"and those cast away in the land of Mitzrayim" —
these are those sunk in the kelipos of the desires.
And through the awakening of the root of the bond
יַחְזְרוּ כּוּלָּם לְשֹׁרֶשׁ קְדוּשָּׁתָם כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל:
they will all return to the root of their holiness, as mentioned above.
עַל הַזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ פָּרָשַׁת אֱמוֹר הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל:
on the holy Zohar in Parashas Emor cited above:
for from a distant place He drew them near to Him,
'Your forefathers dwelt of old beyond the River.'"
which was beyond the river Pras;
וּבָבֶל נִקְרָא רְחוֹקָה נֶגֶד אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל,
and Bavel is called "distant" relative to Eretz Yisrael,
as is brought in the Midrash
"These shall come from afar" — this is Bavel,
"From a distant land they have come to me, from Bavel."
אֵינָהּ רְחוֹקָה כָּל כָּךְ מֵאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל,
is not so far from Eretz Yisrael,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה כג, ב):
"My roads have simply been blocked up."
רַק הַמְכוּוָּן הוּא עַל קְלִיפַּת בָּבֶל,
Rather, what is meant is the kelipah of Bavel;
for the kelipah of Bavel is called "a distant place,"
against the root and source of holiness.
שֶׁקְּלִיפַּת בָּבֶל נִקְרָא גַּם כֵּן רֹאשׁ,
For the kelipah of Bavel is also called "head,"
against the head and source of holiness.
And when the time came for the root
and source of holiness to awaken
in the soul of Avraham Avinu, alav hashalom,
אָז נִתְעוֹרֵר כְּנֶגְדּוֹ בְּזֶה לְעוּמַּת זֶה
then there awoke against it, as its opposite,
the kelipah of Bavel in the generation of the Dispersion,
הָבָה נִבְנֶה לָנוּ עִיר וּמִגְדָּל וְרֹאשׁוֹ בַשָּׁמַיִם,
"Come, let us build ourselves a city and a tower with its top in the heavens,"
which is against the root and source of the holiness
"And He built a tower in its midst
וְגַם יֶקֶב חָצֵב, זֶה הַשִּׁיתִין (סוּכָּה מט, א);
and also hewed out a winepress" — this is the shissin (Sukkah 49a);
and "city" is against the holiness of Yerushalayim.
וְעַל זֶה אָמַר בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל:
And about this it says in the holy Zohar cited above:
אִי יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ הֲוֵי יָדְעֵי דָּא,
why is it written, 'So says Hashem'?
Rather, certainly the hidden point of the matter is:
טִיבוּ סַגִּי עָבֵיד קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל
great kindness did HaKadosh Baruch Hu do with Yisrael,
in that He chose them, etc."
That is, just as at the beginning
שֹׁרֶשׁ הַקְּדוּשָּׁה שֶׁל אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
the root of holiness of Avraham Avinu, alav hashalom,
in utmost distance, in the opposing side,
וְעִם כָּל זֶה נִתְעוֹרֵר שֹׁרֶשׁ וּמְקוֹר הַקְּדוּשָּׁה
and nevertheless the root and source of holiness awoke
through an awakening from Above, by the mercy of Heaven,
"Your forefathers dwelt of old beyond the River" —
for he had been sunk there since days of old —
only through an awakening from Above.
So too, from then until now,
there is awakened every Rosh Hashanah,
in the collective holiness of Yisrael,
the source of the root of holiness from Above,
to draw near every individual soul
שֶׁנִּטְבְּעוּ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם בְּזֶה לְעוּמַּת זֶה,
into which they have sunk, chas v'shalom, in the opposing side,
עַל יְדֵי סְגוּלַּת מִצְוַת תְּקִיעַת שׁוֹפָר,
through the special power of the mitzvah of blowing the shofar,
"A great shofar will be blown, and the lost will come."
And this is the aspect of attachment to the "mazla,"
which is above human knowledge and grasp,
כְּעִנְיַן אָמְרָם זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (מְגִילָּה ג, א):
in the manner of their saying (Megillah 3a):
אַף עַל גַּב דְּאִינְהוּ לָא חָזוּ,
"Even though they themselves did not see,
וְעַל רֶמֶז זֶה יִתָּכֵן מַאֲמַר חֲזַ״ל
And according to this hint one can understand the statement of Chazal
שֶׁנִּתְעוֹרֵר בְּחִינַת מַזָּלָא עִלָּאָה כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל,
when the aspect of the upper mazla is awakened, as said above,
it is the time of bounty for "children,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה י, ב):
בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה נִפְקְדוּ שָׂרָה רָחֵל וְחַנָּה.
"On Rosh Hashanah Sarah, Rachel and Chanah were remembered."
that then is the time when life is bestowed.
וּמְזוֹנֵי גַּם כֵּן נִקְצָבִין בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה,
And "sustenance" too is allotted on Rosh Hashanah,
"For it is a statute (chok) for Yisrael,"
